title: Former Nvidia executive under scanner over sale of servers to China
description:
After Jensen Huang, former Nvidia top executive Jay Puri's relationship with senior tech executive Cenly Chen is under the scanner amid a US investigation into the alleged diversion of the company's servers to China.
Puri, who previously led Nvidia's global sales operations, and Chen, Super Micro's former chief growth officer, dated for several years before marrying on March 7, 2026, the Wall Street Journal reported.
Puri's professional association with Chen has drawn attention because he oversaw Nvidia's global sales and chip allocation. Chen worked closely with the server maker's customers and had regular dealings with Nvidia.
"I never had to rely on personal relationships for professional gain," Chen told the Journal by email.
The Journal said Nvidia and Puri did not respond to its requests for comment. Chen now runs AI computing provider ChronoScale.
